title: Module 1 Quiz: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence

questions.text: What distinguishes an AI system from a simple automated algorithm?
options: AI requires human input each time
AI only works with structured data
AI learns from data and adjusts its behavior
questions.explanation: AI systems learn from data and can change their behavior.

questions.text: What enabled traditional machine learning to move beyond rule-based systems?
options: Algorithms identified patterns from large datasets without explicit rules
Systems relied solely on if-then statements
questions.explanation: ML algorithms find patterns in data without humans writing every rule.

questions.text: True or false: Recommendation engines are designed to discourage spending.
True or false: An algorithm is a step-by-step set of instructions that solves a specific problem or performs a calculation.
questions.explanation: That is the definition of an algorithm.
